tei:div.tei:p: spros bral chung ba bzhugs/ khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang*// bde stong longs spyod rdzogs sku rdo rje sems// sprul pa'i 'khor lo dga' rab rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// 'jam dpal bshes gnyen shrī seng ha dang*// dzñā na sū tra paṇa chen bi ma la// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mtsho skyes rjer// gsol ba 'debs so= rje 'bangs grogs gsum kun mkhyen klong chen pa// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug rig 'dzin 'jigs bral gling*// kun bzang gzhan phan rtsa brgyud bla ma lhar// gsol ba= dbang gis smin cing dam tshig rnam par dag /rim gnyis lam gyi rnal 'byor mtha' ru phyin// mchog thun dngos grub yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog ces pa'ang kun bzang theg mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// rgyal ba mnyam med shākya thub// blo gros mtshungs med pad+ma 'byung*// mkhyen rab mtha' yas klong chen par// gsol ba 'debs 24) so byin gyis rlobs// zhus so// dge'o//
